overloadPatches.semanticRole: Establishes every automatic Many-to-One relation for manyTable at once, loading each related table's related record as its current record.

Looks up the (not necessarily automatic) relation for manyField and loads the related record as current; if choiceField is given and multiple candidates match, shows a selection list to the user instead of failing.

constraints: choiceField must be an Alpha, Text, Numeric, Date, Time, or Boolean field in the related table; Picture, BLOB, and Object type fields are not supported for choiceField, and this command does not support Object type fields for manyField either.

More than one matching record can occur when manyField ends with the wildcard character '@'; the resulting selection list shows related-field values in the left column and choiceField values in the right column, and is skipped automatically when only one match exists.
Passing choiceField is equivalent to specifying a wildcard choice when defining the table relation itself.
